jpy.head: USD/JPY Stalls Near 160 as BoJ Rate Hike Talk Balances Fed Strength

pts: Resistance Near 160
Bulls have faltered near the 160 level while holding above 159, leaving price action in a sideways trend.

Tokyo inflation data is keeping potential Bank of Japan tightening alive, which could offer support to the Yen.
